text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.2773 for the Junior Software Engineer position. Their strongest evidence includes experience with "Node.js" and "Kubernetes," which relate to the javascript and devops requirements. Key gaps include missing must-have qualifications in python and git, as well as several nice-to-have skills like web development frameworks, sql, nosql, html, css, and pytest. Despite these missing requirements and a low overall fit, the application has been escalated for further review.
